[EVENT] User is planning a solo hike this weekend.  
[FACT] User has done a hike recently with amazing views of the Pacific Ocean and the coastline.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for recommendations on trails with great ocean views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended trails in California include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Point Reyes National Seashore: The Point Reyes Lighthouse Trail offers breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean, Drake's Bay, and the surrounding coastline.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Hwy 1 Trail: Runs along the Pacific Coast Highway (Hwy 1) with stunning ocean views, especially around Bodega Bay and Mendocino County.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve: Located in San Diego, with trails like Razor Point Trail and Beach Trail offering ocean views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Montaña de Oro State Park: In San Luis Obispo County, with trails like Valencia Peak Trail and Oats Peak Trail offering ocean views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended trails in Oregon include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Ecola State Park: Trails like Ecola State Park Trail and Tillamook Head Trail offer stunning ocean views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Cape Perpetua Scenic Viewpoint: Near Yachats, with the Cape Perpetua Trail providing more stunning views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended trails in Washington include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Hurricane Ridge: Offers panoramic views of the Strait of Juan de Fuca and surrounding mountains.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Rialto Beach: Near Forks, with the Rialto Beach Trail offering scenic views.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Other recommendations include trails in Big Sur and Santa Barbara County.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested checking trail conditions, difficulty levels, and necessary permits or regulations before hiking.  
[EVENT] User is planning to stay in the Bay Area this weekend.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for more trails with ocean views around Marin Headlands or Mount Tamalpais State Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended trails in Marin Headlands include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Hawk Hill Trail: Moderate 2-mile out-and-back hike with views of the Pacific Ocean and Golden Gate Bridge.
